title: 第19章 这个兵我要了，你不准抢
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: 咕咚咕咚......何镇涛接过递来的大茶缸子，套在嘴上就开始吨吨吨的喝水。高峰急坏了：“说词儿，赶快说词儿啊！”何镇涛放下茶缸，用袖子在嘴上狠狠擦了一把：“说什么词儿？”高峰一拍脑袋：“都给我整糊涂了，我让你讲，团长到底怎么说？”何镇涛清了清嗓子，学着团长那一口地道江城方言说道：“团长说：我当有么子大滴事，搞了半天就是这？关个禁闭，写个检讨，就阔以了嘛。”高峰瞪大眼睛：“就，就没了？”“嗯，就这些。”“团长没发火？”“没有，他说：这些娃娃年纪都还小，不得懂事，才进部队没几天心还在外头飘着，要多下点苦功夫，不然么个让你们来带新兵咧？”“......”“靠！我靠！”高峰抓狂的摘下帽子，气的直跺脚：“关个禁闭写个检讨，就让这事儿过去了？你就没跟团长说，那小子带了一堆违禁品来部队，又是刀子，又是棍子的？”“这种人，要是不给他退了，后头指不定又闹出什么幺蛾子！”“差不多行了，老高，演起来没完了？”何镇涛翻个白眼，直接点破。“特三团是一支英雄部队，你这个连长，把团里的荣誉看的比命都重。”“要真在你手上把人退回去，不光是把你钉在耻辱柱上，团史里也会留下这么一个污点。”“就这样吧，大事化小，小事化了。当地人武部那边，我已经打过招呼，会协调后续工作.......”被戳破的高峰也不再嘴硬，他生气只是想表明一下自已的立场和态度。要真因为“泄密”走退兵流程，整不好上尉连长就是他军旅生涯的尽头。“不管怎么说，这小子反正我是不喜欢！”“流里流气的，哪像是来当兵的！”何镇涛也不和他争：“好好好，回头你讨厌谁，就给他丢到哪个连去。”高峰瞪着眼睛：“嘿，我有那么损吗我？”他摸出一根烟，烦躁的点着：“你说这人跟人的差距怎么就这么大，他就不能脚踏实地的，跟他那老乡学点儿好？”“你说陆阳啊？”“不然呢？”高峰夹着烟说：“这喜欢看书的谈吐气质是不一样啊，晚上这新闻点评，其他人都畏畏缩缩，他就往台上一站，那感觉立马不一样。”“那词儿，怎么说来着，形容有舞台范儿？”“台风？”“对对对，那‘台风’都快赶上你这老政工了。回头要是连里搞个活动，策划个什么演讲，主持个节目什么的，还不手拿把掐？”“是啊，这小子除了体能上弱了点，其他哪儿哪儿都好。”何镇涛也是毫不吝啬对陆阳的夸赞，好像过一阵就能从陆阳身上发现新优点。而且，每样优点都和部队文化宣传方向的职能有关。属于天生就是端文职这碗饭，去公务班的好苗子。“先跟你打招呼，这兵下连了我要带去机关好好培养。”“我去，这么早就跟我要人了？”高峰眼睛瞪大，像是活见鬼似的。何镇涛坦言：“部队里训练好的新兵每年一抓一大把，但像陆阳这样真不多见，我那正好也缺人手。”“另外，往年的考学复习资料，我都提前让人帮着准备好了。下连以后，小陆到了我那，也能认真踏实复习，为考学做准备。”“行了，不早了，你早点儿休息吧。明天后我还得去单独找丁腾飞，做做思想工作。”何镇涛离开后，高峰一脸思索。他显然是没料到，这位老搭档这么早就开始提前要人。并且早早的就开始帮陆阳规划未来发展方向，甚至连考学资料都准备好了？不知道是不是心理作用，原先高峰对陆阳印象只能用“还行”来形容，算不上特别优秀。可当何镇涛说完那些话后，陆阳在高峰心里的地位突然直线拔高，让他有点儿舍不得撒手。尤其，每年搞活动，他们单位活动都搞得一塌糊涂惨不忍睹，所以急需一个在这方面有天赋的兵来把持。高峰掐灭烟头，切了一声：“不就是复习资料，学习环境嘛，又不是只有你们机关单位才能提供？我们七连，要战车有战车，要书桌有战车，要啥有啥！”......月明星稀，宿舍床上的陆阳，刚刚结束完一组小体能。血液循环加速引发的亢奋，让他一时间难以入睡。他双手枕在脑袋底下，盯着头顶床板，脑袋里还在想着白天的事。周凯东的主动承担，看似凶狠实则变相对丁腾飞的保护，让军人形象在他脑袋里变得更立体。责任和担当，也让“军中之母”这四个字变得尤为形象。但这件事，陆阳其实也有少许自责，因为这件事本可以避免。明知道这个老乡性格乖张，喜好炫耀，却没能把他给盯紧了。如果当时陆阳迟点出去给家里打电话，或者让孔垄把人盯住了，或许就不会像现在这样弄得鸡飞狗跳一团糟。“想啥呢，还不睡？”陆阳扭过头，发现周凯东就站在身边。他在给大家盖被子，这是军中的老传统了。气温逐渐变冷，这会儿踢被子是要着凉冻感冒的。陆阳：“我在想，假如白天.......”周凯东抬手打断：“如果一个人想要犯错，总有机会犯错。你已经在能力范围内做到了最好，这事和你没关系，手机也是我让你发下去的。”盯得住一时，盯不了一世。他不可能每时每刻的把注意放在提防丁腾飞犯错身上。即便是这次不犯错，或许下次，下下次，还会可能发生类似的事儿。或者，不声不响的犯了错，却谁都不知道，等造成不可逆的恶劣影响，那才是最可怕的。陆阳唯一能做的，就是做好自已的事，认真训练，认真学习新的东西，努力夯实自身实力。他闭上双眼，开始酝酿睡意，班长帮他把被子往里掖了掖，这样热气就不容易散出来。周凯东直起身，看着陆阳上铺空荡荡的床铺，心情有些惆怅。现在的新兵，一届比一届难带了。“班长......”“干嘛？”孔垄的声音自班长身后响起，连原本快要睡着的陆阳都睁开了眼睛。孔垄面露苦色的揉着肚子：“饿的睡不着，难受。”“我们也是......”紧跟着，一连串的声音便传来，原来大家都没睡着。今天训练量增加了，熄灯后还多了个小体能，陆阳其实也有点儿饿。都是年轻人，十二点吃饭，十二点半饿肚子都很正常，更何况今天消耗量格外大。但对此，周凯东也没有什么解决办法，他这也没吃的了，就算有也不够这么多嘴分。都说半大小子，吃穷老子，这一大帮年轻人，得吃多少东西才能吃饱？“饿就忍着，赶紧睡觉，睡醒就吃早饭了！”众人无奈，只能重新躺回床上，但咕噜噜的肚子叫声却此起彼伏。饿的滋味是真难受，尤其是半夜又馋又饿的那种，是真遭罪。好在没过一会大家便逐渐睡去，咕咕叫声也变成了有节奏的呼噜声。.......“嗝~今天早上这肉包子，可给我吃爽了！”“对了，丁腾飞的那瓶牛奶，还有鸡蛋，最后被谁吃了？”“还用问，肯定是孔垄啊，成天搞体能肌肉咔咔掉，他不得多补充点儿蛋白质？”“这两天吃的是真爽，多个人的饭菜量就是不一样；回头等那家伙走了，咱们是不是顿顿都能这么吃？”“想啥呢？那小子走了，不还得再补个人上来嘛，是吧班副？”“之后的小值日都机灵点，别太老实了，能多打的绝对不拿少，就算其他班老兵不满，也不用理会。吃到咱肚子里的，才是自已的......”陆阳最后的这番话，引起大家狠狠赞同。刚来那会儿太老实，生怕打多了会引起老兵不满。后果就是，其他班吃的肚儿圆，自已班上没一会就饿肚子。在部队里什么都得争，什么都得抢，尤其是在吃的问题上绝对不能怂，甚至有时候还得“偷奸耍滑”。比如，陆阳现在的口袋里，就揣着俩捏扁的花卷，这是他先前偷偷顺来的。准备回头训练完，肚子饿的时候再拿出来吃。回到宿舍班长不在，陆阳便以班副身份代行班长职务，安排大家抓紧整理内务打扫卫生。这时，外头传来一阵脚步声，紧跟着班长和指导员便领着一个家伙出现在门口。此刻的丁腾飞相较两天前看着憔悴多了，眼圈黑黑的，看着蔫儿蔫儿的。很显然，关禁闭的滋味非常不好受。“进去吧，下次绝对不能再犯这样的错误了！”“是......”随着丁腾飞回归，班上气氛也出现了些微妙变化。像是突然塞进来一个不相干的陌生人，让大家感觉很不自在。
content_en: Gudong, Gudong... He Zhentao took the big tea vat that was handed to him, put it on his mouth and started drinking tons and tons of water.Gao Feng was anxious: "Say something, say something quickly!" He Zhentao put down the teapot and wiped his mouth hard with his sleeve: "What words are you talking about?" Gao Feng slapped his head: "I'm confused. I'll let you tell me, what did the regiment leader say?" He Zhentao cleared his throat and imitated the regiment leader's words.Speaking in Jiangcheng dialect, "The leader said: What big thing did I do? I have been doing it for a long time and this is it? Just put me in solitary confinement and write a self-criticism. That's enough." Gao Feng widened his eyes: "Just, it's gone?" "Well, that's it." "The leader didn't get angry?" "No, he said: These babies are all oldI'm still young, I can't be sensible.I've only been in the army for a few days and my heart is still wandering.I need to work harder, otherwise why would you be asked to lead new recruits??Didn't you tell the commander that that kid brought a bunch of contraband to the army, including knives and sticks?"If you don't get rid of this kind of person, there might be something wrong in the future!""That's alright, Lao Gao, the show is over?"He Zhentao rolled his eyes and pointed it out."The Third Special Regiment is a heroic unit. You, the company commander, value the honor of the regiment more than your life." "If I really send people back in your hands, not only will you be nailed to the pillar of shame, but also such a stain will be left in the history of the regiment." "That's it, big things will be reduced to trivial matters. I have already said hello to the local military department and will coordinate the follow-up work..." Gao Feng, who was exposed, no longer spoke harshly. He just wanted to express his position and attitude when he was angry.If he really goes through the withdrawal process because of "leakage", the captain and company commander will be the end of his military career."Anyway, I don't like this kid anyway!" "He's so arrogant, he doesn't look like he's a soldier!" He Zhentao didn't argue with him: "Okay, okay, fine, fine, whatever company you hate later, just throw him into whatever company you want." Gao Feng glared: "Hey, am I that bad?" He touched me.He took out a cigarette and lit it irritably: "Why do you think the gap between this person and others is so big? Why can't he be down-to-earth and learn from his fellow countrymen?" "You mean Lu Yang?" "Otherwise?" Gao Feng said while holding a cigarette: "This person who likes to read books has a different style of conversation, WanWhen other people were commenting on the news, he stood on the stage, and the feeling was different immediately."What do you mean, it's like a stage?"Events, planning a speech, hosting a program, etc., why don't you take care of him?""Yes, except for his physical weakness, this guy is good at everything else." He Zhentao also praised Lu Yang without hesitation, as if he would be able to find new strengths in Lu Yang after a while.Moreover, each advantage is related to the function of military cultural propaganda direction.He is a good candidate who is born to be a civil servant and goes to the public service class."I want to say hello to you first. I'm going to take this soldier to the agency for training." "I'll go, you want someone from me so early?" Gao Feng's eyes widened, as if he had seen a ghost.He Zhentao said frankly: "There are a lot of well-trained recruits in the army every year, but they are rare like Lu Yang, and I happen to be short of manpower." "In addition, I have asked people to prepare the review materials for previous years' exams in advance. After I go to the company,When Xiao Lu comes to my place, he can study hard and prepare for the exam."Okay, it's getting late. You should go to bed early. I have to go to Ding Tengfei alone to do some ideological work after tomorrow."After He Zhentao left, Gao Feng looked thoughtful.He obviously didn't expect that his old partner would start asking for people in advance so early.And he started helping Lu Yang plan his future development direction early, and even prepared the examination materials?I don't know if it was a psychological effect, but Gao Feng's impression of Lu Yang could only be described as "okay", not particularly outstanding.But after He Zhentao said those words, Lu Yang's status in Gao Feng's heart suddenly skyrocketed, making him a little reluctant to let go.In particular, their unit's activities were a mess every year, so they were in urgent need of a soldier with talent in this area to control them.Gao Feng stubbed out the cigarette butt and said: "Isn't it just review materials and learning environment? Isn't it only your agency that can provide it? Our Seventh Company has tanks and tanks, desks and tanks, everything you need!"... The moon was shining brightly. Lu Yang, who was sitting on the bed in the dormitory, had just finished a set of small physical exercises.The excitement caused by the accelerated blood circulation made it difficult for him to fall asleep for a while.He put his hands under his head and stared at the bed above his head, still thinking about the day's events.Zhou Kaidong's initiative and commitment, which seemed to be fierce, actually turned out to be protective of Ding Tengfei, making the image of a soldier more three-dimensional in his mind.Responsibility and responsibility also make the four words "mother of the army" particularly vivid.But Lu Yang actually felt a little guilty about this incident, because it could have been avoided.Although he knew that this fellow had a perverse personality and liked to show off, he failed to keep an eye on him.If Lu Yang had gone out later to call home, or had Kong Long keep an eye on the person, maybe he wouldn't have been in such a mess."What are you thinking about? You're not sleeping yet?" Lu Yang turned his head and found Zhou Kaidong standing next to him.He was tucking everyone in, which is an old tradition in the military.The temperature is gradually getting colder, and you will catch a cold if you kick the quilt now.Lu Yang: "I was thinking, if during the day..." Zhou Kaidong raised his hand and interrupted: "If a person wants to make a mistake, there is always a chance to make a mistake. You have done the best within your ability. This matter has nothing to do with you. I also asked you to pass on the mobile phone." You can keep an eye on him for a while, but you can't keep an eye on him forever.He couldn't pay attention to Ding Tengfei making mistakes all the time.Even if you don't make a mistake this time, maybe something similar will happen next time, and the next time.Or, you may make a mistake silently, but no one knows about it. The most terrible thing is when it causes irreversible bad effects.The only thing Lu Yang can do is to do his own thing well, train seriously, learn new things seriously, and work hard to consolidate his own strength.He closed his eyes and began to feel sleepy. The monitor helped him tuck the quilt in so that the heat would not escape easily.Zhou Kaidong straightened up and looked at the empty bed above Lu Yang, feeling a little melancholy.Today's new recruits are becoming more and more difficult to train each time."Squad leader..." "What are you doing?" Kong Long's voice sounded from behind the squad leader, and even Lu Yang, who was about to fall asleep, opened his eyes.Kong Rong rubbed his stomach with a bitter look on his face: "I'm so hungry that I can't sleep, it's uncomfortable." "We are too..." Immediately afterwards, a series of voices came, and it turned out that no one was asleep.The amount of training increased today, and after lights out, he gained a little extra energy. Lu Yang was actually a little hungry.They are all young people. It is normal to eat at twelve o'clock and be hungry at twelve thirty, not to mention that today's consumption is particularly large.But Zhou Kaidong didn't have any solution to this problem. He didn't have anything to eat, and even if he had, it wouldn't be enough to talk about it.It is said that half-grown children live in poverty. How much food do these young people need to eat to be full?"Just endure it when you're hungry, go to bed quickly, and have breakfast when you wake up!" Everyone had no choice but to lie back on the bed, but their stomachs growled one after another.The feeling of hunger is really uncomfortable, especially when you are hungry and hungry in the middle of the night. It is really painful.Fortunately, everyone gradually fell asleep after a while, and the cooing turned into rhythmic snoring...... "Hiccup~ I enjoyed eating these meat buns this morning!" "By the way, who ate Ding Tengfei's bottle of milk and eggs in the end?" "You don't have to ask, it must have been Kong Long. His muscles are chipping away from doing physical exercises all day long, so he doesn't need to add more protein?" "It's been really good to eat these two days, and the amount of food for multiple people is different; we'll wait until that guy leaves.Do we eat like this every day?""What are you thinking about?Now that the kid is gone, you have to bring someone up, right?" "Be smart in the next day, don't be too honest, and don't take anything less if you can.Even if the other veterans are dissatisfied, you don't have to worry about it. It's yours who eats it..." Lu Yang's last words aroused strong agreement from everyone.When I first came here, I was too honest, and I was afraid that if I beat him too much, I would cause dissatisfaction among the veterans.The consequence is that while other classes are full of food, those in my own class will be hungry soon.In the army, you have to fight for everything and grab everything, especially when it comes to food. You must not be cowardly, and sometimes you even have to "cheat and cheat."For example, Lu Yang currently has two flattened flower scrolls in his pocket, which he had secretly brought in earlier.Prepare to go back and finish training, and then take it out to eat when you are hungry.When the squad leader returned to the dormitory, Lu Yang took over the duties of squad leader as the squad deputy and arranged for everyone to clean up the house as soon as possible.At this time, there was a sound of footsteps outside, followed by the squad leader and instructor leading a guy to appear at the door.At this moment, Ding Tengfei looked much more haggard than he did two days ago, with dark circles under his eyes, and he looked wilted.Obviously, confinement is very uncomfortable."Go in, you must not make such a mistake next time!" "Yes..." With Ding Tengfei's return, there were some subtle changes in the atmosphere in the class.It was like an unrelated stranger suddenly came in, making everyone feel very uncomfortable.
